name: Facet
text: Choose dark mode by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low light and keeps the interface sleek, matching Manus’ competitive dark theme and Graphify’s interactive graph. The trade-off is that light mode users must click once, but the default stays optimal for most users.

name: Pane
text: Dark mode hides errors when contrast drops—Manus’s analysis warns this. A one-click toggle forces users to discover the risk themselves; better to default to high-contrast light mode and let users opt into dark mode. Settle it by testing error detection rates in both modes with real users.
